add.k: A flying robot head, captain of a Ravager clan
st: After Yondu's death, Mainframe rejoins Stakar's old team of Ravager captains and tells them how much she missed them.
Mainframe warns the Guardians they are being boarded by the United Ravagers, who turn out to be Gamora's crew.

files.notes: Uncredited voice in Vol. 2 (her 'I miss you guys so much!' with Stakar's old team), credited in Vol. 3. The group is The Ravagers (the United Ravagers is said on screen in Vol. 3; kept under the app's existing Ravagers name, as Fitz-Gibbonok's file does). Checker: the pickup of Gamora at the end of Vol. 3 is unconfirmed (the line has no speaker), so it is left out of the step and the ties.

add.k: A veteran Ravager loyal to Yondu
st: Tullk warns Taserface to watch what he says about Yondu, then cries mutiny and is thrown out an airlock for staying loyal.

files.notes: Lines confirmed in the transcript ('You best be very careful what you say about our captain', 'This is mutiny!', 'You're scum!').

add.k: A cyborg bird, one of the High Evolutionary's Hellspawn
st: Behemoth keeps Nebula out over her gun arm, then leads the Hellspawn into Knowhere until Cosmo crushes him.

files.notes: Lines confirmed: 'Policy against weaponry, and your arm is a gun' and 'A dog!'. Group follows War Pig's file (OrgoCorp); 'Hellspawn' is said on screen but kept in k, not as a group.

add.k: An OrgoCorp administrator on the Orgoscope
st: Kwol spots Mantis and Drax and sends the Orgosentries after them, and Gamora shoots her in the leg to make a point.

files.notes: Credited 'Administrator Kwol' (Wikipedia and the credits list), as the app files 'Master Karja'; the batch gives 'Kwol', kept as an alias. If the owner wants the batch form, n = 'Kwol'. That Gamora's 'the one that looks like a carrot' is Kwol follows the wiki.

add.k: A bat-like Humanimal living on Counter-Earth
st: Neelie takes the Guardians home, points them to the pyramid and lends them her car, then dies when Counter-Earth is destroyed.

files.notes: She speaks only her own untranslated language, so her lines are not in the subtitles; the scene shows her talking with Quill. No group is named on screen: Independent.

add.k: An Extremis soldier hooked on the doses Savin brings
st: Taggart takes a case of Extremis doses from Savin at the Chinese Theatre, then overdoses and explodes, badly hurting Happy.

files.notes: Credited only as 'Taggart' (credits list and Wikipedia); 'Jack Taggart' is the wiki's full name, kept as an alias. If the owner wants the batch form, n = 'Jack Taggart' (id st-jack-taggart). Group A.I.M. as for Ponytail Express (A.I.M. is named on screen; that Taggart is one of Killian's Extremis men is shown through Savin). His former Army service is never shown, so it is left out.

add.k: Head of the Department of Damage Control
st: Hoag takes the alien salvage job away from Toomes's crew for Damage Control and stops her guards from arresting him.

files.notes: Checker: the wiki puts her team at the wrecked Queens bank later in the film, but she has no lines there and nothing is said of her; at most a silent glimpse, so the one step for the film stays on the salvage scene.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: After Yondu's funeral, Stakar says Yondu would be proud to see his old team back together. Mainframe happily rejoins, saying she missed them all.
stages.whoA: Stakar, who brings her old team back together
stages.whoB: Mainframe, a captain on his old team

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Martinex and Mainframe are both captains on Stakar's old team. They reunite after Yondu's death and agree to steal together again.
stages.whoA: Martinex, a fellow captain on Stakar's team
stages.whoB: Mainframe, a fellow captain on Stakar's team

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Mainframe and Martinex ride with the United Ravagers who board the Guardians' ship. Mainframe gives the warning before the Ravagers storm aboard.
stages.whoA: Martinex, a fellow captain in the United Ravagers
stages.whoB: Mainframe, a fellow captain in the United Ravagers

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Mainframe tells the Guardians to surrender or die as the United Ravagers board them. Quill protests that he is one of them, and it turns out Gamora is waiting.
stages.whoA: Peter Quill, an old Ravager she threatens to board
stages.whoB: Mainframe, who warns him he is being boarded

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Tullk is a veteran of Yondu's crew and defends him when Taserface calls him soft. When the mutiny comes, he is beaten and thrown out an airlock as the bound Yondu watches.
stages.whoA: Yondu, the captain he dies loyal to
stages.whoB: Tullk, a loyal veteran of his crew

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Tullk warns Taserface to be careful what he says about their captain. Taserface leads the mutiny anyway and has Tullk thrown out an airlock.
stages.whoA: Taserface, the mutineer who has him killed
stages.whoB: Tullk, a Yondu loyalist he has killed

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Tullk and Kraglin sit together when Taserface whispers that Yondu has gone soft. Kraglin's outburst helps start the mutiny that kills Tullk, which Kraglin then regrets.
stages.whoA: Kraglin, a crewmate on Yondu's ship
stages.whoB: Tullk, a crewmate killed in the mutiny

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Behemoth guards the High Evolutionary and stands beside him when Quill comes to bargain. When the Guardians attack his ship, the High Evolutionary sends the Hellspawn out against Knowhere.
stages.whoA: The High Evolutionary, who made and commands him
stages.whoB: Behemoth, one of his Hellspawn guards

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Behemoth and War Pig guard the gate to the High Evolutionary's lab together. War Pig clears Quill to enter while Behemoth keeps Nebula out over her gun arm.
stages.whoA: War Pig, a fellow Hellspawn guard
stages.whoB: Behemoth, a fellow Hellspawn guard

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: At the lab's gate, Behemoth scans Nebula and tells her she must stay outside because her arm is a gun. Nebula is left waiting while Quill and Groot go in.
stages.whoA: Nebula, whom he bars from the lab
stages.whoB: Behemoth, the guard who keeps her outside

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Kraglin fights Behemoth's Hellspawn on Knowhere with Yondu's arrow, but Behemoth dodges it. As Behemoth closes in, Cosmo steps in to protect Kraglin.
stages.whoA: Kraglin, the Ravager he nearly kills
stages.whoB: Behemoth, the Hellspawn who corners him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Behemoth laughs when a dog stands between him and Kraglin. Kraglin tells him she is a good dog, and Cosmo crushes him with two slabs of rock.
stages.whoA: Cosmo, the dog who crushes him
stages.whoB: Behemoth, the Hellspawn she crushes

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Kwol watches the Orgoscope's cameras and reports trouble to Karja, who runs its guards. Later both watch Adam and Ayesha question a captured Ravager.
stages.whoA: Master Karja, head of the Orgoscope's guards
stages.whoB: Kwol, an administrator who works with him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Kwol raises the alarm on the Guardians and sends the Orgosentries after them. When Gamora storms her office, she shoots Kwol in the leg to show they mean business.
stages.whoA: Gamora, who shoots her in the leg
stages.whoB: Kwol, the administrator she shoots

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Kwol recognizes Mantis and Drax from the day's warning despite their OrgoCorp uniforms. She calls the Orgosentries on them, and the two have to fight their way through.
stages.whoA: Mantis, one of the intruders she spots
stages.whoB: Kwol, who sees through her disguise

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Neelie trips fleeing the Guardians on Counter-Earth, and Quill cleans her knee to show they mean no harm. She takes them home, points them to the pyramid and lends him her car, which he crashes.
stages.whoA: Peter Quill, the stranger she helps
stages.whoB: Neelie, the Counter-Earth woman who helps him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Neelie hosts the Guardians in her home while Drax sprawls across her couch with his boots on her pillows. Drax stays behind with Rocket when the others head for the pyramid.
stages.whoA: Drax, the rude guest on her couch
stages.whoB: Neelie, the Humanimal whose couch he takes

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Savin meets Taggart outside the Chinese Theatre with a case of Extremis and asks if he can regulate. Taggart says he can, but when Happy grabs the case, he takes too much and explodes.
stages.whoA: Savin, who brings him his Extremis doses
stages.whoB: Taggart, an Extremis soldier he supplies

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Happy follows Savin to the Chinese Theatre, bumps into Taggart and takes one of his doses. Taggart calls for Savin's help, then explodes, leaving Happy badly hurt.
stages.whoA: Happy, who catches his deal with Savin
stages.whoB: Taggart, whose blast puts him in the hospital

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Hoag arrives with Damage Control and tells Toomes his crew is off the salvage job. When he begs and then punches one of her men, she calls off her guards and tells him to take it up with her superiors.
stages.whoA: Toomes, the salvager she shuts out
stages.whoB: Hoag, the official who takes his job

dropped.why: No lines of his own. The only line tagged to him ('RETCH: Move!' on Berhert) is a known subtitle mislabel: the wiki says the Ravager who corners Rocket with Brahl is wrongly called Retch in the subtitles. 'Can I smash it with a rock?' is Gef's ('No, Gef'), and the party lines over Groot are not said by anyone the dialogue or the wiki ties to Retch.

changes.was: Mainframe warns the Guardians they are being boarded by the United Ravagers, then comes with Martinex to collect Gamora.
changes.now: Mainframe warns the Guardians they are being boarded by the United Ravagers, who turn out to be Gamora's crew.
changes.why: Not confirmed that Mainframe comes to collect Gamora: the closing 'Hey, Gamora. Are you ready?' has no speaker in the transcript and no source but the wiki's own summary puts her there. The boarding warning ('you're about to be boarded by the United Ravagers... Totes up to you') and Gamora waiting ('You're early', 'So, you're a Ravager now?') are confirmed.

changes.was: Mainframe rides with Stakar's United Ravagers when they surround the Guardians' ship. They take Gamora back into their ranks.
changes.why: Stakar is not in the boarding scene (he speaks only at the end, 'Welcome home' to Gamora), and Mainframe's presence at the end is unconfirmed, so they share no confirmed scene in Vol. 3.

changes.now: {"text": "Mainframe and Martinex ride with the United Ravagers who board the Guardians' ship. Mainframe gives the warning before the Ravagers storm aboard.", "whoA": "Martinex, a fellow captain in the United Ravagers", "whoB": "Mainframe, a fellow captain in the United Ravagers"}
changes.why: Collecting Gamora together is unconfirmed (the closing line has no speaker); the two are confirmed together only in the boarding.
The tie rested on Mainframe and Martinex collecting Gamora, which is unconfirmed; otherwise they only share the boarding scene with no exchange between them.
